_doc: Kinds of place on the maps (add-map-legend): the legend's order, the name it shows, the marker's colour and the icon in ui/map/icons/places/ (white SVG, tinted by nothing: the disc carries the colour). A kind missing here gets the 'missing' icon and its id as the name. A kind with a `title` ("{street} Parking") names each place from its nearest street, shortened with street_suffixes and street_directions, instead of by its address; its `note` is the second line in the legend (one line: keep it short).
